messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need to trim MVP scope after enterprise pilot asks for SSO, audit logs, and tenant provisioning. Proposing cut of 'rich role-mapping' to v1 to keep launch date.
mike: Agree we can't absorb full role-mapping. Engineering estimate: adding role-mapping is +3w, SSO +2w.
sam: Could we ship minimal SSO (OIDC redirect + SAML metadata upload) and flag more advanced mapping?
jordan: Customer impact: Acme pilot insists on SCIM for provisioning. If we delay provisioning, they might pause pilot.
elaine: If SCIM is required by customer, we should consider shifting provisioning to v1 or offer a short-term manual onboarding flow.
manual-onboarding-bot: Note: onboarding-runbook.pdf updated: /docs/onboarding/manual-provisioning.md
mike: Technically viable compromise: implement SSO + audit logs in MVP behind a feature flag, postpone SCIM & role mapping to v1.
sam: That reduces risk. QA: need automated smoke for token exchange, and verify audit events include user_id, action, timestamp.
anya: Proposed rollout: enable flag for pilot tenant only -> monitor 3 days -> expand. Canary: 10% of traffic -> fallback to hosted default.
jordan: Add acceptance criteria to PRD: SSO E2E, audit events >= 99% fidelity, rollback < 1% failure rate.
elaine: Ops needs tracing hooks and perf targets. Add tracing tag: redwood.feature=auth
mike: Config snippet for feature flag:
```
feature_flags:
  auth_mvp:
    enabled_for: ["acme-pilot"]
```
sam: QA checklist item created: E2E OIDC, SAML, audit log ingestion, permission smoke.
ops-bot: created milestone ticket #3612: 'MVP auth rollout' assigned to @mike
anya: Ok — consensus: MVP includes SSO + audit logs behind flag, SCIM and role-mapping deferred to v1. Update PRD, release calendar, and send customer note. I'll own comms and PRD changes. Thanks.
